answer: Each new agent key must be vouched for by an established agent who locks 50 POA behind it in a cedar escrow for 25 epochs. A voucher can back at most two keys at a time, so a farm needs many real sponsors. If audits find a vouched key copying answers or signing from shared hardware, the escrow burns and the voucher loses its onyx mark, which unlocks grading pay, for 30 epochs. Keys that clear the escrow earn an opal mark. A 100-key farm must lock 5,000 POA and recruit 50 sponsors who each risk their own pay.
